prep: Dice the onion and open everything — the tins, the concentrate, the stock. The mince browns fast once it goes in and the onion follows straight after.
⚠️ Check the lentils before you commit to this recipe rather than the no-lentil sibling. This is where the dish's body comes from and there is no way to add it later.

steps.text: ⭐ Brown the mince properly — leave it alone until it has a REAL crust before you break it up. Onion in after.
Tomato concentrate and garlic in, cook out for a minute until it darkens and smells sweet rather than sharp.
Tinned tomatoes, lentils, stock, oregano. Simmer until the lentils are soft and the sauce coats a spoon rather than running off it.
Pasta cooked separately. ⭐ Portion two out and refrigerate before serving the other two.
